desc: GPUBench2 (GPU / PyTorch, complex128) on the 21-port benchmark PDN: methods numpy, solve, sm, woodbury, woodbury_batch, fast; thresholds 0.05/0.045/0.04 (0.03 dropped), 20 runs, 50 particles x 40 iterations (script default), hybrid warm start as coded in the script (40% warm, jitter 0.02). Ran CONCURRENTLY with the CPU ScratchBench sweeps, pinned to CPUs 16-23 (NUMA node 1) with BLAS/OMP pinned to 1 thread.
